component.name: Ilmenyx Controller
component.summary: Hardware diagnostics, monitoring and benchmarking for Linux
Diagnóstico, monitoramento e benchmarking de hardware para Linux

description.p: Ilmenyx Controller shows what is inside your computer — CPU, memory, GPU, disks, sensors, battery and network — and measures its performance.
Read-only by default, no telemetry, no hidden sudo, and no invented data: when a sensor does not exist, Ilmenyx Controller says so.
An independent, unofficial Linux adaptation of RESET EXPLODE by Gustavo (GustavoReset); not affiliated with or endorsed by the RESET team.
